title: What If Obi Wan Was Expelled From The Order After His Unauthorized Mission To Mandalore
description:
What if Obi-Wan Kenobi was expelled from the Jedi Order after his unauthorized mission to Mandalore? Following the death of Duchess Satine, Obi-Wan finds himself blamed for a devastating political crisis, forcing the Jedi Council to make an impossible decision. Stripped of everything he has spent his life fighting for, Obi-Wan must discover who he truly is without the Order, while Anakin Skywalker struggles with the loss of his former master.

As a mysterious new warrior emerges within the Separatist ranks, the Jedi find themselves facing an enemy unlike anything they have encountered before. And for Obi-Wan Kenobi, the greatest challenge of the war may be one he never could have imagined.

title: What If Luke Skywalker Gave In To The Dark Side To Kill Palpatine
description:
What if Luke Skywalker gave in to his hatred and killed Emperor Palpatine aboard the Second Death Star? With the Emperor dead and the Empire collapsing, Luke believes he has finally brought peace to the galaxy, but the darkness he embraced refuses to leave him. As he struggles to rebuild the Jedi Order, a mysterious woman from Palpatine's past enters his life, offering guidance through the very darkness he fears. And as Luke grows more powerful, the fate of the Skywalker family may depend on whether he can escape the same path that once destroyed his father.

With the fate of Anakin, the Jedi Order, and the entire Republic hanging in the balance, a single intervention from Qui-Gon could change everything.

description:

His journey eventually leads him to Tatooine, where a reunion with his oldest enemy takes a turn neither of them could have imagined. And as the galaxy approaches a turning point, the choices of two former enemies could change its destiny forever.

With no knowledge of his true potential, Anakin's relationships with the Jedi, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and even Chancellor Palpatine could develop very differently. And as the galaxy descends into the Clone Wars, Anakin's unknown destiny could change the fate of the Jedi, the Sith, and the entire Republic.
